title: gate-demo-sync-parity
liveReferenceCommandApplicability: N/A — gate-demo-sync-parity is a pure deterministic bun test gate, intentionally NOT registered in LIVE_REFERENCE_TEST_PATHS and capturing no live Win32 window, so the conditional `bun run plan_final/test-live-reference.ts ...` verification command does not apply to this step.
resolution: Demo sync is an intrinsic deterministic DOOM property (a recorded demo is a fixed ticcmd stream replayed through the same LCG/P_Ticker path every run), so 'zero checkpoint drift' is well-posed reference-independently even though the three read-only checkpoint fixtures (capture-demo{1,2,3}-playback-checkpoints.json) declare their live framebuffer/audio/state hashes null/pending (no captured oracle exists). The gate asserts, each zero-difference: (1) the three read-only checkpoint fixtures are well-formed deterministic contracts (schemaVersion 1, named demo lump, tic-monotone checkpoint schedule from 0, ordered checkpoint trace, stable 64-hex trace digest), reparsed twice → byte-identical; demo1 pins the `bun run doom.ts` target-playable contract while demo2/demo3 pin the local DOS reference -timedemo/-playdemo command for the same lump; demo2's self-described `JSON.stringify(expectedTrace)` traceSha256 is recomputed and verified EXACTLY (736f0d08…); (2) each bundled demo (DEMO1 5026 tics, DEMO2 3836, DEMO3 2134, loaded from the reference DOOM1.WAD) replays byte-identically across two independent runs through the committed purpose-built deterministic replayer replayDemo{1,2,3}Deterministically — each of which itself throws unless every parsed tic is consumed and the demo completes with the vanilla attract `advance-demo`, so a successful call is a zero-desync assertion; (3) two independent committed DemoPlayback streams of each demo produce a byte-identical cumulative-ticcmd checkpoint-hash vector at every in-range read-only-contract checkpoint tic (zero checkpoint drift), all terminating `advance-demo`. Focused gate PASSED 4/4 (0 fail, 86 expect()s); tsc 0; format clean.
